blocks.raw: # Responding to verification of payee check requests
blocks.text: Responding to verification of payee check requests

blocks.raw: For Modulr accounts, incoming name check requests from other institutions are handled automatically. Our Routing Verification Mechanism (RVM) partner compares the payer-provided name with the Modulr account name and returns the match result.
blocks.text: For Modulr accounts, incoming name check requests from other institutions are handled automatically. Our Routing Verification Mechanism (RVM) partner compares the payer-provided name with the Modulr account name and returns the match result.

blocks.raw: No integration or action is required from customers.
